content.short: VyFinance is a DEx & DeFi protocol within the Cardano ecosystem.
content.description: VyFinance is a DEx & DeFi protocol within the Cardano ecosystem. In addition to building a DEX, VyFinance has been one of the principal software innovators in the Cardano ecosystem. Thus far we have been instrumental in creating first time applications such as governance, a functional lottery design, NFT staking, stakeless LPs, Layer Two LPs, multi-currency token staking and our Bar in which a certain percentage of fees accumulated from our ecosystem are distributed to our VYFI holders.
content.meta: Find out about VyFinance (VYFI) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
